name: web_search_local
description: [LOCAL — FALLBACK] Web search via DuckDuckGo running on this machine. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets (results may be sparser, no citations). PREFER the server-side `web_search` tool for normal use — only use this one when the user explicitly asks for a local/offline/private search, or when `web_search` is unavailable or failing.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10)
